5 days | Amboseli, Salt Lick, Tsavo West and Tsavo East

Package overview

A southern circuit from Nairobi. Two nights in Amboseli for Kilimanjaro and elephants, then Tsavo West, the Salt Lick waterhole, and Tsavo East.

A first Kenya safari built around elephants. Highlights: Amboseli elephants, Kilimanjaro views, Tsavo’s red dust country.

Route Nairobi → Amboseli → Tsavo West → Tsavo East → Nairobi

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi to Amboseli

Leave after breakfast. The drive through Emali takes about five hours. An afternoon game drive looks for the Amboseli herds. Overnight in Amboseli.

Accommodation: Amboseli

02Day 2 | Amboseli

Morning and afternoon drives on the plains. Elephants are the point of this park. Kilimanjaro is visible when the cloud lifts, which is more likely at dawn.

Accommodation: Amboseli

03Day 3 | Amboseli to Tsavo West

Drive of about three to four hours into Tsavo West. Mzima Springs is included when the gate timing allows. Overnight beside the Salt Lick waterhole.

Accommodation: Tsavo West

04Day 4 | Tsavo West to Tsavo East

A morning in Tsavo West, then across to Tsavo East. The red elephants are usually near water: Aruba Dam or the Galana River, depending on the season.

Accommodation: Tsavo East

05Day 5 | Tsavo East to Nairobi

Sunrise drive, then about six hours back to Nairobi. The trip ends at your hotel or the airport. A coast drop at Mtito Andei can replace the Nairobi return.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
